why: RJ-H02, pending PH-5 (halo/placed-images): a logo reveal. Places a 480 x 160 SVG logo (red left half, blue right half) centred in a 1080p composition over a black solid, keys scale from 0 to 1 and opacity from 0 to 1 over 5 s (frames 0 to 150) with an overshoot ease, and exports frame 150 as a PNG; the H.264 movie renders on macOS only (render.start), where PH-m checks it in the scoped run. Until PH-5 the render draws a solid's colour, not its picture, and place.image is registered at PH-6, so platforms is [] and the harness skips the job on both. The trap: the movie shows the solid's colour or a stretched logo, or the scale key doesn't reach the picture. The assertion: at frame 150 (800, 540) is red and (1120, 540) blue within 2/255, and (700, 540), just left of the logo, is black. The turn-on sets platforms to linux and macos.
